source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Punjab grows three potato crops: a spring crop and an autumn crop in the plains, and a summer crop in the hilly areas.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: About 75% of Punjab's potatoes come from Kasur, Okara, Depalpur, Sahiwal and Pakpattan.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: All varieties released by the Potato Research Institute, Sahiwal, are sown in the second half of October.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Two of the Potato Research Institute, Sahiwal's varieties are recommended for Gujranwala (and Sialkot): Sialkot Red (SH-1035), released 2018. Red skin. Average yield 25.8 tonnes per hectare. High yield, climate resilient, tolerant of frost and disease. SH-5, released 2006. Red skin. Average yield 35.0 tonnes per hectare. Late maturing, tolerant of frost and disease.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Sahiwal Red (FD 76-67): released 2019. Red skin. Average yield 28.4 tonnes per hectare. Recommended areas: Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Kasur. Traits: high yield, frost and disease tolerant.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Sahiwal White (FD 73-110): released 2019. White skin. Average yield 30.5 tonnes per hectare. Recommended areas: Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Kasur. Traits: high yield, climate resilient, frost and disease tolerant.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Cosmo (FD 78-51): released 2019. Yellow skin. Average yield 29.9 tonnes per hectare. Recommended areas: Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Kasur. Traits: high yield, frost and disease tolerant.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Sialkot Red (SH-1035): released 2018. Red skin. Average yield 25.8 tonnes per hectare. Recommended areas: Sialkot, Gujranwala, Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Kasur. Traits: high yield, climate resilient, frost and disease tolerant.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Sadaf (FD 78-36): released 2016. White skin. Average yield 26.6 tonnes per hectare. Recommended areas: Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Kasur. Traits: climate resilient, frost and disease tolerant, good for processing.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: Ruby (FD 63-1): released 2016. Red skin. Average yield 27.3 tonnes per hectare. Recommended areas: Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Kasur. Traits: late maturing, frost and disease tolerant, good for processing.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
text: PRI-Red (FD 70-1): released 2013. Red skin. Average yield 34.2 tonnes per hectare. Recommended areas: Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Kasur. Traits: late maturing, frost and disease tolerant.

source: محکمہ زراعت پنجاب، آلو کا صفحہ
